summary: Consolidated Business Requirements Document (BRD) and Functional Requirements Document (FRD) for the In-WhatsApp Message Scheduler Chatbot. Covers executive vision, business rules, financial unit economics, detailed functional modules (FR-AUTH, FR-WIZ, FR-CLI, FR-SCHED, FR-REC, FR-REL, FR-META), and the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
